title: Law Of Evidence Ii
modules: Exceptions To The Rule Against Hearsay Rule Ii
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a balance between probability and improbability."
The standard is a balance between probability and improbability.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a double edged weapon as it entitles the prosecution also to advance evidence of bad character, if any."
Evidence of good character is a double edged weapon as it entitles the prosecution also to advance evidence of bad character, if any.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any representation of fact or opinion made by a person by whatever means; and may be assertive non-assertive or mixed."
A statement is any representation of fact or opinion made by a person by whatever means; and may be assertive non-assertive or mixed.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the party's duty to prove, by weight of evidence the totality of the truth or some proportion of fact, which is vital to the case and which is also in issue."
The burden of proof refers to the party's duty to prove, by weight of evidence the totality of the truth or some proportion of fact, which is vital to the case and which is also in issue.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is that which is admissible because it is closely connected to the fact in issue."
Similar fact evidence is that which is admissible because it is closely connected to the fact in issue.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an innovation bringing law of evidence in line with contemporary development."
Electronic device is an innovation bringing law of evidence in line with contemporary development.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a competent witness and may give evidence in his own defence."
An accused is a competent witness and may give evidence in his own defence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means evidence relating to a contract but not appearing on the face of the contract."
Extrinsic evidence means evidence relating to a contract but not appearing on the face of the contract.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a means of proof or of providing particular facts."
Hearsay rule is a means of proof or of providing particular facts.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in relation to the law of evidence, it might be signifying ''reputation'' which is what the people tends to know about the person."
More often time when ''character'' is used in relation to the law of evidence, it might be signifying ''reputation'' which is what the people tends to know about the person.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the rule of evidence, which prevents a party from denying the truth of some statement, formerly made by him or her."
The doctrine of estoppels is the rule of evidence, which prevents a party from denying the truth of some statement, formerly made by him or her.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the ground or reasoning upon which the opinion is founded."
The foundation refers to the ground or reasoning upon which the opinion is founded.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the establishment of a fact by proper legal means to the satisfaction of the court."
Proof is the establishment of a fact by proper legal means to the satisfaction of the court.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the mirror of accepted usage."
Customary law is the mirror of accepted usage.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a person especially skilled in the field of foreign law, native law and Custom, of science or art, handwriting and finger print analysis."
An expert is a person especially skilled in the field of foreign law, native law and Custom, of science or art, handwriting and finger print analysis.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the mental ability to understand problems and make decisions, the capacity to understand proceedings - whether or not a witness may legally give evidence in a court proceeding."
Competency is the mental ability to understand problems and make decisions, the capacity to understand proceedings - whether or not a witness may legally give evidence in a court proceeding.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a substantive law; it contains a substantive law."
The Evidence Act is a substantive law; it contains a substantive law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a shield, not a sword, a defence; not a cause of action."
Estoppel is a shield, not a sword, a defence; not a cause of action.
fib: ______ are an extension of the rules on confession.
Judges rules
Judges rules are an extension of the rules on confession.
______ is a means but proof or disproof is the end product.
Evidence
Evidence is a means but proof or disproof is the end product.
______ is the evidence that tend to establish the fact in issue by proving the previous similar acts or omissions of the accused person.
Evidence of Similar Facts
Evidence of Similar Facts is the evidence that tend to establish the fact in issue by proving the previous similar acts or omissions of the accused person.
______ is the testimony by a witness of what other persons have said, not what he or she knows personally.
Hearsay
Hearsay is the testimony by a witness of what other persons have said, not what he or she knows personally.
______ is a written record of what the deponent has said.
deposition
A deposition is a written record of what the deponent has said.
______ refer to information relating to their field of expertise that has come to them as a second hand (this rule is an exception to the hearsay rule) 4.
Experts may
Experts may refer to information relating to their field of expertise that has come to them as a second hand (this rule is an exception to the hearsay rule) 4.
______ means the evidence of a person's moral standing in community based on reputation.
Character evidence
Character evidence means the evidence of a person's moral standing in community based on reputation.
______ is the production of the original document for the inspection of the Court.
Primary evidence
Primary evidence is the production of the original document for the inspection of the Court.
______ is a special legal right, exemptions, or immunity granted to a person or class of persons.
Privilege
Privilege is a special legal right, exemptions, or immunity granted to a person or class of persons.
______ is a cause of action, but the doctrine of Estoppels is not.
Misrepresentation
Misrepresentation is a cause of action, but the doctrine of Estoppels is not.
______ means lineage, descent, and succession of families, line of ancestors from which a person descends genealogy.
Pedigree
Pedigree means lineage, descent, and succession of families, line of ancestors from which a person descends genealogy.
______ is a competent witness for the prosecution, the defendant and for a codefendant.
accused's spouse
An accused's spouse is a competent witness for the prosecution, the defendant and for a codefendant.
______ is an admission made at any time by a person charged with a crime, stating or suggesting the inference that he committed that crime. (Sec. 27(1)).
confession
Definition A confession is an admission made at any time by a person charged with a crime, stating or suggesting the inference that he committed that crime. (Sec. 27(1)).
______ is the right of the party that called the witness and it exists once there has been cross examination.
Re-examination
Re-examination is the right of the party that called the witness and it exists once there has been cross examination.
______ is the case of Boardman v Director of Public Prosecutions [1974] 3 All E.
Noteworthy
Noteworthy is the case of Boardman v Director of Public Prosecutions [1974] 3 All E.
______ is a person who has been connected in the commission of a crime; a person who, on the evidence, may be convicted of the offence with which an accused is charged.
accomplice
An accomplice is a person who has been connected in the commission of a crime; a person who, on the evidence, may be convicted of the offence with which an accused is charged.
______ is the confirmation, ratification, verification, or validity of an existing evidence in some material particular from another independent witness or witnesses implicating the accused.
Corroboration
Corroboration is the confirmation, ratification, verification, or validity of an existing evidence in some material particular from another independent witness or witnesses implicating the accused.
